subject: Re: Request for temporary burst headroom & blended true-up structure

Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary burst headroom + blended true-up

Hi Hannah,

We're ramping a product feature next week that will spike inference traffic for ~72 hours (peak forecasts ~6x baseline). We expect the volume to be transient (two weekends of heavy traffic) but it's critical for our go-live.

Ask: can Redwood provide a temporary quota increase (burst headroom) for July 9–11 and July 16–18, and offer a blended overrun true-up so the surge doesn't show up at retail overage rates? Our finance team would prefer a single blended rate for the additional token consumption rather than unpredictable per-token overrun pricing.

Attached: a short usage snapshot for May and our launch forecast.

No firm legal changes needed — we're mostly asking for a commercial carve-out and a short approval path. If there are standard guardrails (caps, per-day limits, auto-throttle triggers) we can accept those. Also: who signs off on a provisional credit or discount — is that sales or finance?

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of Product
Northbound Analytics

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the heads up and the forecast. We can definitely help smooth this so launch isn't blocked. I'm looping in Karthik from pricing to propose options and our finance lead for approvals.

Couple of quick clarifying Qs so we size the guardrails correctly:
- Do you expect the 6x peak to be sustained continuously for 72 hours, or are there hourly spikes inside that window?
- Are all requests hitting a single model endpoint/route, or will traffic be split across several models?
- Any contractual constraints from your side about retroactive invoices or PO changes?

I'll get you a proposed structure (two options: a provisional burst credit vs. a blended overrun rate) by end of day tomorrow.

— Hannah

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NB burst ask — pricing options draft

Hannah / Jordan — draft notes below for a call with Sanjay tomorrow. I sketched two paths with numbers using their May baseline + 6x peak assumptions:

Option A — Provisional burst credit (preferred for short windows)
- Grant 500M token provisional credit across the two weekends (split as 250M / weekend).
- If usage <= credit, zero overrun charge. If usage > credit, apply standard overrun rate on excess.
- Price: offer a 35% discount off standard overrun rate for the provisional credit consumption. This is sales-approved up to $15k economics; anything beyond requires finance sign-off.

Option B — Blended true-up (preferred by finance for predictability)
- Measure incremental tokens consumed during burst windows and invoice at a single blended rate for that increment for the month.
- Blended rate = (standard overrun rate * (1 - 0.25)) for burst periods — i.e., 25% off retail overrun.
- Requires a short statement of work / amendment (1 paragraph) and finance acceptance; invoiced in the monthly invoice following the burst.

Operational guardrails (both options)
- Per-minute auto-throttle at 120% of baseline sustained RPS to prevent runaway cost.
- Canary: initial ramp cap at 40% of requested burst for first 3 hours to validate performance.
- Logging: we retain detailed token-level usage for the two weekends for audit.

Attachments: NB_proposal_blended_trueup_v1.pdf (draft commercial language).

LH: For anything beyond $15k net economics we need Laura (finance) to OK and we should route to legal for a 1-paragraph amendment.

— Karthik
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@northbound-analytics.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@northbound-analytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary burst headroom & blended true-up structure

Sanjay — thanks for the patience. Based on your forecast we can offer two concrete paths:

1) Provisional burst credit (quick execution) — recommended if you need an on‑the‑spot capacity lift
   - 500M token provisional credit covering both weekends (we'll track daily).
   - Consumption against the credit billed at a 35% discounted overrun rate; any excess billed at standard overrun.
   - Sales can approve this up to $15k; if you expect higher economics tell us now and we'll route to finance.

2) Blended true-up amendment (finance-friendly, single-line charge)
   - We compute incremental tokens consumed during the burst windows and apply a single blended rate equal to 75% of standard overrun for that increment.
   - Requires a one-paragraph amendment (attached) and will appear on the invoice for July (billing cycle following usage).

Operational safeguards for both: auto-throttle at 120% baseline sustained RPS, 3-hour canary ramp, detailed token-level logs retained for audit.

If you prefer option 2 we'll send the amendment as a DocuSign (fast path). If option 1, we can provision the credit immediately and confirm the cap/guardrails. Either path we can commit to <24h execution once you confirm.

Next steps: please reply with: A) preferred option, B) whether the $15k sales approval is sufficient or whether we should engage finance, C) any PO or billing constraints.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20m call if helpful.

— Hannah
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
